card: This PR relaxes constraints on Bitcoin Core's external_signer wallet flag by making it mutable via setwalletflag and no longer requiring private keys to be disabled. It also ensures blank wallets with external signers do not automatically import keys, and adjusts PSBT filling to sign with local keys before delegating to the hardware signer. This solves architectural limitations that blocked hybrid hot-and-cold setups required for MuSig2 and multisig descriptor workflows. Importance is demonstrated by unblocking external signer MuSig2 integration.
changed_since_previous: Rebased on top of recent wallet RPC argument parsing refactors without altering the core behavior or approach.

enables: MuSig2 multisig support involving external signers (Sjors/bitcoin#91)

evidence: PR description: 'The constraints aren't a problem for the main supported and documented use case of connecting a single hardware wallet and using it just like a normal single sig Bitcoin Core wallet. But they get in the way of MuSig2 support, see https://github.com/Sjors/bitcoin/pull/91.'
Commit 91c0e4445d: 'Before this change the external_signer flag required the wallet to be watch-only. This precludes multisig setups in which we hold a hot key.'
problem: External signer wallets were required to have private keys disabled and the flag could not be mutated after creation. This prevents hybrid setups such as multisig or MuSig2 where a wallet combines local hot keys with an external hardware signer, and prevents starting from a blank wallet to import custom multisig descriptors.

risk.why: Mistakes in wallet reloading or PSBT filling could disrupt concurrent RPC operations or produce malformed transactions in hybrid hot and hardware key wallets.

scope_notes: Extracts wallet RPC load/unload helpers to support on-the-fly wallet reloading when changing flags that affect ScriptPubKeyMan construction.
summary: Relaxes constraints on the `external_signer` wallet flag so external signer wallets can hold private keys and have their signer status toggled after creation. Allows `createwallet` with `blank=true` to skip importing external signer keys, reloads the wallet automatically when toggling `external_signer` via `setwalletflag`, and updates PSBT filling to sign with internal hot keys before calling the external device.
